notes.title: OMINA MORTIS
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018028/3807ea72e2f1daff24f1f4bd61dc96ff541fd7e9.png[/img]

[b]Omina Mortis[/b] – gothic thriller in medieval style.

[b]Omina Mortis[/b] is a bold experiment in interactive fiction that is steeped in medieval aesthetics and symbolism. Peril noiselessly slips from shadow to shadow throughout the fog-laden streets of the Forgotten Kingdom as you descend deeper and deeper into its dark, demonic mystery.

The game will become available in Steam in Autumn 2017 in 5 languages. You can already find more details about the game on its Steam page!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/644340/Omina_Mortis/
